name: How much does a garage conversion ADU typically cost in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: How much does a garage conversion ADU typically cost in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a garage conversion ADU in Orange County varies significantly based on factors like the garage's size, existing structural conditions, desired finishes, and plumbing/electrical needs. A basic conversion might start around $80,000 to $100,000, while more complex projects with high-end finishes or extensive structural modifications could exceed $150,000. This includes design, permits, and construction. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation to assess your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a garage conversion ADU in Orange County typically range from $80,000 to over $150,000, depending on size, finishes, and structural work.
